summary: Compose a small invented settlement around a memorable landmark, readable paths, and contrasting building silhouettes.
objective: Create an explorable miniature world with a coherent visual story and room for unexpected architecture.
example_prompts: Build a hillside village whose lanterns collect falling stars.
Make a rainy miniature settlement growing around an enormous teapot.

entities.name: Landmark
entities.guidance: Choose one strong silhouette and give it breathing room.

entities.name: Homes and gathering spaces
entities.guidance: Vary roof profiles and clustering; connect entrances to visible paths.

entities.name: Terrain and vegetation
entities.guidance: Use terraces, roots, or islands to organize depth and sightlines.

creative_affordances: Start with a story constraint: what do the inhabitants value, collect, or fear? Let it shape the landmark and daily-life details.
Explore asymmetry, improbable materials, exaggerated scale, and palettes beyond conventional medieval fantasy.
Use a limited family of shapes for cohesion; reserve a contrasting shape for the landmark.
Choose orbit inspection, a few authored viewpoints, or a static composition according to the requested artifact.
motion_guidance: Optional lantern sway, drifting leaves, or chimney wisps can suggest life without forcing a population simulation.
Provide a still or reduced-motion presentation; keep decorative motion separate from camera input.
known_limits: Entirely invented setting; no claim of historical, structural, or ecological accuracy.
Spatial readability and style guidance are editorial suggestions, not universal aesthetic rules.
No bundled models, textures, or observed render evaluation.
